attributes.action: Hold a referendum to rejoin EU
attributes.additional_details:
Benefits of being part of EU:
1) Has kept the EU in peace. 
2) Creates work opportunities. 
3) Provides national security in numbers. 
4) Better bargaining 
5) Opportunities to retire to the sun. 
6) Manages immigration. 
7) Access to study opportunities 
8) AI regulation 
9) Opportunities to reduce costs
10) Democratic seat at the table
attributes.background: Hold a referendum to rejoin the EU.

rejection.details:
